title: Make remote test-run observer equality account explicitly for every native-origin field
outcome: RemoteTestRunIdentity equality continues to exclude causal custody deliberately while requiring an explicit decision when TestRunNativeOrigin gains fields.
acceptance: Equality compares all intended observer identity fields while excluding causal custody, and a new native-origin field cannot silently escape that decision.
Behavioral identity/conflict tests preserve equality for custody-only differences and detect differences in the remaining observer fields.
